# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Binding and documentation updates**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.154 builds package XML API documentation and synchronize generated native bindings with bundled sources. NuGet consumers receive API documentation sidecars alongside the packages, while generated interop stays aligned with the bundled Skia and HarfBuzz sources.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **XML API documentation ships with NuGet packages** — SkiaSharp packages now include XML documentation sidecars, so IDE tooltips and API reference information are available directly to package consumers. ([#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066))
